fusions.name: Clamp Down
fusions.desc: A clamping bite that deals 12 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Worrying Grip
fusions.desc: A held, shaking bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Pass the Pain
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from the ally who needs it most. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Locked Jaw
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
